run_nav_compare: run the navigation comparison script with a route index to compare learned vs BD API navigation
run_baseline_navigate: run baseline navigation using BD API set_base_position to move the robot to a goal waypoint
run_learned_navigate: run learned navigation using a trained policy to navigate the robot to a goal waypoint
run_return_to_start: run the return to start function to move the robot back to its starting waypoint
run_main: run the main comparison loop that executes 3 episodes each of learned and baseline navigation
